items.prompt: A grid contains tokens 001, A2 and 03. What may the spiral algorithm change?

options.text: It may replace 001 with 1 because they parse equally.
options.why: The contract preserves token spelling. Numeric equivalence does not authorize conversion.

options.text: It may sort A2 after all numeric-looking tokens.
options.why: The visit order follows coordinates; token categories do not affect it.

options.text: It may overwrite caller cells with visit numbers.
options.why: The shown function reads input cells and builds a separate result. Caller mutation is not part of the contract.

options.text: Only their visit order, preserving each token text.
options.why: This is traversal, not numeric conversion, token replacement or mutation of the input grid.

items.explanation: This is traversal, not numeric conversion, token replacement or mutation of the input grid.
